segments.contextAfter: Call [`addUIInterruptionMonitor(withDescription:handler:)`](xctestcase/adduiinterruptionmonitor(withdescription:handler:).md) with a block that handles the interrupting UI and gets the test back on its expected path.

segments.contextAfter: UI interruption monitors are stored in a stack and their blocks are tried in last-in, first-out order, so returning `false` gives other interruption monitors the chance to run.
